entities.name: Elephant
entities.description: A creature type for large pachyderms, including mammoths and mastodons, appearing most often in white and green.

entities.name: Loxodons
entities.description: Sentient, anthropomorphic elephant folk found on several planes, known for ties to nature and community.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The most naturalistic Ravnican guild, which most Ravnican loxodons seek to join and whose arboretum structures they build.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: A Ravnican guild in whose ranks some loxodons may be found.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Brought loxodons to Mirrodin via his soul traps.

entities.name: Ghalma the Shaper
entities.description: Accompanied by the last remaining living loxodons on New Phyrexia, settled in Bladehold.

entities.name: Machine Orthodoxy
entities.description: The Phyrexian sect whose invasion of the Razor Fields isolated the remaining loxodons.

entities.name: Razor Fields
entities.description: A Mirrodin region inhabited by loxodons who believed in the Modest Truth.

entities.name: Modest Truth
entities.description: A code of absolute morality of the Mirran loxodons.

entities.name: Armodons
entities.description: Nearly extinct elephants native to Rath with several sets of tusks and horns.

entities.name: Terastodons
entities.description: Colossal rhino-like relatives of elephants on Zendikar.

events.summary: As Mirrodin becomes New Phyrexia, the Machine Orthodoxy's invasion of the Razor Fields isolates the remaining loxodons.
events.quote: the Machine Orthodoxy's invasion of the Razor Fields isolated the remaining loxodon

events.summary: Loxodons are brought to Mirrodin through Memnarch's soul traps.
events.quote: Loxodons were brought to Mirrodin via Memnarch 's soul traps.

relations.quote: Most of the Ravnican loxodons seek membership in the Selesnya Conclave

relations.note: the last living loxodons accompany him
relations.quote: The last remaining living loxodons on the plane are the ones who accompany Ghalma the Shaper
